tests.detail: Two independent authorized purchases each complete.
Each purchase has its own completed capture and entitlement.
A lost capture answer cannot turn one purchase into a second order.
A fresh worker reconciles the captured order and grants once.
The missing answer is resolved by a supported order read.
Every dispatched write carries an explicit conservative provider request UUID.
Concurrent delivery IDs do not become separate purchase identities.
A durable unique purchase claim survives independent processes.
An account mismatch has no provider effects.
An unknown create without a resource ID remains protected and cannot be searched by request ID.
Order COMPLETED does not imply its capture is COMPLETED.
Pending money stays protected across repeated deliveries.

Each quoted seat is granted once.

A store outage is not disguised as a provider result.
